leaves.name: lichtenbaumProjective
leaves.doc: p1-quot2: Lichtenbaum's projectivity theorem (Lichtenbaum 1968 Thm 2.8; Liu, Algebraic Geometry and Arithmetic Curves, Thm 8.3.16), case S = Spec R with R a DVR: X integral, regular, of dimension 2, proper and flat over S is projective (closed immersion into P^n_S over S). Replaces mcr-glue's composite L1 ProperCurveAF (EGA II 4.5.4 and dim 2 proved in Lean).
leaves.source: S. Lichtenbaum, Curves over discrete valuation rings, Amer. J. Math. 90 (1968), Thm 2.8; Q. Liu, Algebraic Geometry and Arithmetic Curves (Oxford 2002), Thm 8.3.16 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: finiteQuotientExists
leaves.doc: mcr-glue L2: quotients of a proper Z_(p)-scheme with affine-neighbourhood property by a finite group exist and are finite (SGA 1 Exp. V Prop. 1.8 with 1.1; special case).
leaves.source: SGA 1 Exp. V, Prop. 1.8 with Prop. 1.1 and Cor. 1.5 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: tameQuotientSmoothRelDim
leaves.doc: p1-quot2: the smoothness half of mcr-glue L3: the quotient of a proper smooth relative curve over Z_(p) by a finite group of order prime to p (SGA 1 quotient, q finite) is smooth of relative dimension 1 (composite: tame quotients commute with base change, normal curves over perfect fields are smooth, EGA IV 17.5.1). The properness half of L3 is proved in Lean (QuotientP1/QuotProper.lean).
leaves.source: SGA 1 Exp. V Prop. 1.9 / Mumford, Abelian Varieties sec. 7 (tame base change); Stacks 00TV; EGA IV 17.5.1 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: smoothModelOfP1
leaves.doc: mcr-glue L4: a proper smooth Z_(p)-curve with generic fibre P^1_Q is P^1_{Z_(p)} (consequence; no printed statement located).
leaves.source: Liu, Algebraic Geometry and Arithmetic Curves, sec. 8.3 and 10.1 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: edixhovenFixedSmooth2
leaves.doc: p1-quot: Edixhoven's tame fixed-point theorem for a group generated by two automorphisms over Z_(p): the fixed scheme X^G of a finite group G of order invertible on S acting on a smooth S-scheme X is smooth over S.
leaves.source: B. Edixhoven, Neron models and tame ramification, Compositio Math. 81 (1992), 291-306, Prop. 3.4 (locator UNVERIFIED)
